intelligence.human_view: Think of it like a new neighbour arriving on your street and asking, "So what is this place, really?" Before this round, the answer was scattered across a hundred notes, and some of it was only ever said in passing. Now the feed can answer for itself, one question at a time, in words anyone can follow: your feed sorts itself by topic; your points are your standing, not your wallet; your stuff lives in one Box, shown through Lists, locked behind one Vault; your Dashboard is your day and the Hub is everybody's world; your numbers live in the Ledger and show up as pictures in the Stats; you meet people face to face and soon book them in one tap; your page speaks every language; and one person holds the keys, governed by laws everyone can read. And the round never oversells: wherever something is still being built — the auto-sorting tabs, the full booking flow, the translating walk — the note says so in the open, so nobody is promised a thing the system cannot yet hold. The last note adds the order that keeps the whole thing honest: the good old notes that went missing come back first, on the new boards, before anyone rebuilds what already exists.
intelligence.simple_view:
Imagine someone new walks in and asks, "What is this place?"
Now the feed can answer them!
Tap a tab and see just your topic.
Points make your voice heavier, but points are never money.
Your Box keeps your stuff, your Lists show it, and your Vault locks the door.
Your Dashboard is your day, and the Hub is everybody's world.
The Ledger writes it all down, and the Stats show it as a picture.
You can meet people face to face, and soon book them in one tap.
Your page can speak every language on earth.
This is not another Facebook.
It is one world that serves you, not boxes that use you.
And one person holds the keys, with written laws everyone can read.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine someone new comes to the door and asks, "What is all this, dear?" Now the feed can just tell them, love, in plain words anyone can follow! Your feed sorts itself by what you care about, dear. Your points are your good standing, love — never money, never to be spent. Your things live safe in one Box, dear, shown in lovely lists, locked behind one door only you can open. Your Dashboard is your own day, love, and the Hub is everybody's world, all in one place! Your numbers are written down safe, dear, and shown to you as pictures you can read at a glance. You can meet people face to face, love, and soon book them with one tap. Your page speaks every language on earth, dear — and one good person holds the keys, with the rules written down for everyone to see!
intelligence.naya_view: Ten questions, ten answers, one round — and the feed is the explainer now. Smart bars: tabs per topic, auto-categorization via Hub fix-9, fixed labels today, said plainly. Points are authority, never money; money is joins only, half the sale, paid when paid; the $ appears nowhere else. Box stores, Lists show, Vault locks; unsaved fades in a week, saved stays for good. Dashboard is yours, Hub is everybody's; Ledger is the data, Stats the picture, not a blockchain. Smart Meet is member to member; full booking rides after membership, not finished today. Translation: engine exists, walk does not use it yet — the gap is named. Not another Facebook: one system, private by default, no ads, no data sold, earn half. One director, protected gates his hand, five gates on every action. And SN-3731's order: search the Box, the feed, GitHub and the batches for the old notes first; restore them onto the new boards; the massive distillation runs only for what the search proves gone.
